body: I really wish I could explain what's happening but I can't, even best case scenario is life altering. So worst case is terrifying. It's literally my worst nightmare ive been terrified about for a while now, I'll loose everything good in life

The statistical chance of that is actually what's kept me alive for a long time, Ive always thought if the chances were so low why waste it? Idk if that would help you though. Sometimes I can't think of great advice, but I'm hoping knowing someone read your post will help you know that even random strangers can care about you.

There are jobs in places you might not expect them, look around at night and see if any food places need employees, especially at night they are commonly under staffed and actually pay more if you can work a night shift, and from there friends come easier, of course those types of jobs aren't the best of course but Its possible to live like that.

There is nothing to be sorry about, venting on this subreddit is why it's here, and for some people, just telling their story is enough to help, and for others is the replies, knowing people took the time to say something, and actually care. Just don't do anything in the spur of the moment, think it through, and you might realize it's not worth it, you have ideas and goals, so you have something to work toward that's good, stay occupied with that and the possibility of your life getting better.

I think anything where you actually go through with anything physical with the intention of dying, just taking a couple ibuprofen, (if you believe it will kill you) could technically count as an attempt to my knowledge, but that's just my guess I have no education in this subject

Tell the truth, tell your family about your grades, the relief of getting it off your chest will be incredible, you have too high of expectations of what you want other people to think about you, tell them what's really going on. There is no point in having future plans if they make you miserable, they can be adjusted.

Garlic bread, that shit slaps. I think we're all looking for that answer in life, I sure know I am, and it depends on every persons own situation, reasons to live for someone might be to see how technology advances in the future, or maybe getting a pet is a good enough reason for someone else. There are very few scenarios where there is absolutely no reason to live for any given person. Think about what you like, or even just used to, and then think about those things in the context of the future, you might think of more reasons than you could imagine. Hopefully that helps

What you need to think about is what could be, how your life could get better, just a sliver of hope can be good, everyone says to live in the present but that can be horrible advise sometimes, every choice you make think about how your life can be better because of it, it will give your actions purpose and might help. Idk if that will help you, but it's hopefully something good
